# Subtitle Generator (`eyevinn-auto-subtitles`)

Effortlessly transform audio and video files into accurate subtitles with Automatic Subtitle Generator. Utilizing Open AI Whisper, enjoy seamless integration to transcribe and format content efficiently.

[Service documentation](https://docs.osaas.io/osaas.wiki/Service%3A-Subtitle-Generator.html) · [Source](https://github.com/Eyevinn/auto-subtitles)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "eyevinn-auto-subtitles"
  name       = "mysubtitles"

  parameters = {
    openaikey          = "..."
    # awsAccessKeyId     = "..."
    # awsSecretAccessKey = "..."
    # awsRegion          = "..."
    # s3Endpoint         = "..."
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `openaikey` | string | yes | Your OpenAI API key required to access OpenAI Whisper service for audio transcription and subtitle generation |
| `awsAccessKeyId` | string | no | AWS Access Key ID for authenticating with AWS services, specifically needed when uploading subtitle results to S3 |
| `awsSecretAccessKey` | string | no | AWS Secret Access Key that pairs with the Access Key ID for secure authentication with AWS services |
| `awsRegion` | string | no | The AWS region where your S3 bucket or other AWS services are located |
| `s3Endpoint` | string | no | Custom S3 endpoint URL for connecting to S3-compatible storage services or specific AWS S3 endpoints |

The instance `name` must match `^\w+$` and be unique per service within the workspace. OSC lowercases it and allows at most 20 characters.

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
